attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Colorado state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Colorado generally conforms to federal IRC with some modifications.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: // Initialize Colorado income adjustments; set result.co_state_additions = 0.0; set result.co_state_subtractions = 0.0;

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Colorado state additions and subtractions; // Calculate Colorado state additions and subtractions; set result.co_state_additions = result.co_us_interest_income; set result.co_state_subtractions = result.co_state_tax_deduction;

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Colorado corporate income tax. Applies Colorado flat rate (4.55%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: // Initialize Colorado tax calculation; set result.co_taxable_income = 0.0; set result.co_tax_liability = 0.0;

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Colorado corporate tax (flat rate 4.55%); // Calculate Colorado taxable income and tax; set result.co_taxable_income = (result.co_apportioned_income + result.co_state_additions - result.co_state_subtractions); set result.co_tax_liability = result.co_taxable_income * result.co_corp_tax_rate - result.co_state_credits; set result.co_refund_or_owed = result.co_estimated_payments - result.co_tax_liability;
action_details.action_dsl: if result.co_apportioned_income + result.co_state_additions - result.co_state_subtractions > 0.0 then set result.co_taxable_income = result.co_apportioned_income + result.co_state_additions - result.co_state_subtractions; else set result.co_taxable_income = 0.0; endif if result.co_taxable_income * result.co_corp_tax_rate - result.co_state_credits > 0.0 then set result.co_tax_liability = result.co_taxable_income * result.co_corp_tax_rate - result.co_state_credits; else set result.co_tax_liability = 0.0; endif set result.co_refund_or_owed = result.co_estimated_payments - result.co_tax_liability;
action_details.action_postfix: { result.co_apportioned_income result.co_state_additions f+ result.co_state_subtractions f- cvd /result.co_taxable_income xdef } { 0.0 cvd /result.co_taxable_income xdef } result.co_apportioned_income result.co_state_additions f+ result.co_state_subtractions f- 0.0 f> ifelse { result.co_taxable_income result.co_corp_tax_rate fmul result.co_state_credits f- cvd /result.co_tax_liability xdef } { 0.0 cvd /result.co_tax_liability xdef } result.co_taxable_income result.co_corp_tax_rate fmul result.co_state_credits f- 0.0 f> ifelse result.co_estimated_payments result.co_tax_liability f- cvd /result.co_refund_or_owed xdef
